name: WayriCAD BOM Studio
description: KiCad-first BOM workbench with embedded desktop UI, parts catalogue, distributor splits and assembler-specific CSV/Excel exports.
description_full: Complete 3.1.0 PCM developer preview, not a profile-only patch. Retains native-first field templates, embedded desktop launcher, catalogue/assets/native library creation, variants, checks, analytics and CLI/job-set tools. Adds built-in per-board assembler BOM mappings for JLCPCB, PCBWay, HQPCB, NextPCB, Sierra Circuits, PCB Power, Seeed Fusion and generic assembly. CSV/XLSX/TSV and multi-profile ZIP exports are integrated into GUI and CLI. Distributor split exports remain separate: assembly quantities are never multiplied by procurement settings. Unverified/custom provider mappings require review. No automatic upload, order, CPL or Gerber generation. Actual KiCad/Windows/macOS/portal host acceptance is unexecuted. First setup requires Python and declared dependencies; no browser runtimes or wheels are bundled.
